description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API endpoints related to employee directory functionalities. It includes test cases for retrieving individual and multiple employee entries, as well as verifying that create, update, and delete operations are not implemented.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPITest
classes.description: A test class for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI to validate API responses and ensure correct behavior of employee directory endpoints, including retrieval operations and non-implemented methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for fetching a single employee directory record using predefined test cases.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for fetching all employee directory records using predefined test cases.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create operation is not implemented and triggers the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures the validation rules for creation are not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update operation is not implemented and triggers the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures the validation rules for update are not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete operation is not implemented and triggers the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures the validation rules for delete are not implemented.
